original: 会社をクビになったけど、貯金がすこしあるので、差し詰め生活には困らない。

en.text: I got the sack but I've a little saved up, so for the time being I won't be troubled by living expenses.
I got fired from the company, but since I have a little money saved up, for the time being, I won't have trouble with living expenses.
